integrity: The elementary Gaussian-binomial counting arguments and accompanying finite checker are self-reviewed; no independent scientific audit or external validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed prime-power field, square-zero differentials chosen uniformly, independent random half-dimensional subspace; only a joint three-statistic limit and one first-order nonconvergence witness are established.
title: Critical random-subspace detection of homology in uniform square-zero linear maps
